manifest.name: parse_bank_and_customer_ledgers
manifest.description: Parses Czech bank_statement.csv and customer_invoices.csv (semicolon, decimal comma) into clean records with ISO dates and float amounts.
manifest.notes: bank_statement.csv: Datum(dd.mm.yyyy);Částka;Měna;Protistrana;VS;Zpráva;Zůstatek, amounts like '-68 000,00', utf-8 (maybe BOM), CRLF. customer_invoices.csv: cislo_faktury;odberatel;datum_vystaveni;datum_splatnosti;castka_kc. Customer payments have VS=invoice number without FV prefix.

files.test_impl.py:
import pytest
from impl import run


def test_example():
    r = run({'folder': 'novak_trading'})
    assert len(r['customer_invoices']) == 22
    assert r['customer_invoices'][0]['amount_czk'] == 69010.98
    assert r['customer_invoices'][0]['issue_date'] == '2026-07-01'
    assert r['bank_transactions'][0]['amount'] == -68000.0
    assert r['bank_transactions'][0]['date'] == '2026-07-05'


def test_tmp(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    d = tmp_path / 'inbox' / 'x'
    d.mkdir(parents=True)
    (d / 'bank_statement.csv').write_text('Datum;Částka;Měna;Protistrana;VS;Zpráva;Zůstatek\n01.02.2026;1 250,50;CZK;A;1;m;2 000,00\nbad;x;;;;;\n', encoding='utf-8')
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    r = run({'folder': 'x'})
    assert r['bank_transactions'][0]['amount'] == 1250.5
    assert len(r['bank_transactions']) == 1
    assert r['errors']


def test_bad():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        run({})
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        run({'folder': 'nope_missing'})
